decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because the extra amount falls within the restaurant tip allowance. TXN-008120 at Lumen Kitchen (MER-000065, category RESTAURANT) is on card CRD-000105. It posted on 2026-07-18 for 5519 cents. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 99 days later, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The authorisation AUTH-008308 was approved by chip and PIN for 5018 cents. No receipt is attached. The cardholder's figure of 50.18 EUR is their own claim, not a receipt, and it matches the authorised amount. The posted amount is 501 cents above the authorised amount. The limit is 20% of 5018, which is 1003.6 cents. Under amount-restaurant-tip, a restaurant may post up to 20% above the authorised amount to add a tip, and a difference within that limit counts as an agreed tip, not a mismatch.

proposed_actions.reason: Your Lumen Kitchen payment was authorised for 50.18 EUR and posted for 55.19 EUR. The extra 5.01 EUR is less than 20% of the authorised amount, the most a restaurant may add as a tip. Under our policy this counts as an agreed tip, not a charging error.
